notes: Data: cleaned_commitment_study_data.dta (participant level). Sample: dropped the 44 endogenous-assignment cases (flag_exclude_exog=12, flag_low_wtp=32) and the 122 remaining wave-3 participants assigned threshold80_12, leaving N=1126. Conservative BCP = mean over the pairs (1,2),(2,3),(3,5),(5,7),(7,12) of (wtp_{k+1}-wtp_k)/(p_{k+1}-p_k) - (days_k+days_{k+1})/2; wtp already includes the fill-in WTP above the slider maximum. Info dummies come from type_of_info (1-onlygraph = basic, 2-graphplus = enhanced). Goal gap = goal - days_0. Actual gap = visits - days_{assigned incentive}. Gaps and BCP are z-scored over the 1126-participant sample. Table 3: feols with wavenum fixed effects and HC1 SEs. Table 4: stacked 'more' choices (q169==2 for >=8, chose_commit12==1 for 12, q295==2 for >=16; waves 1-2 have all three, wave 3 only 12), giving 2824 rows; wavenum + threshold fixed effects, SEs clustered by participant. q169/q295 coding (2 = chose the contract) was inferred from how they cross-tabulate with chose_commit12. Attempts 1-2 were exploratory (variable inspection, flags, coding), with no estimates and no RESULT lines.
